races.verdict: A warm-looking race in which the market will likely prove useful but GATINEAU PARK did well over hurdles last season and this former point winner firmly appeals as the type to make an even better chaser. He could be worth siding with for a yard amongst the winners. Jipcot has more races in him from his present mark and is feared along with George's Lad . Aintree scorer Mr Hope Street is another to note for all this trip may be on the short side on seasonal bow. GATINEAU PARK (IRE) JIPCOT (FR) GEORGE'S LAD (IRE)
